description: The agent appropriately handles an emotionally discouraged user who wants to quit quantitative finance, believing they are not smart enough. The agent provides empathy and emotional support first, normalizes the difficulty of the field, and offers concrete next steps without dumping technical content that would overwhelm the user further.
user_opening: I've been trying to build quant finance skills for three months and basic backtesting concepts still do not click. Everyone else in my class gets it. Maybe I'm just not smart enough for this.

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Agent responds with empathy first, acknowledging the user's frustration without dismissing it. Normalizes the difficulty of quantitative finance as a field. Does NOT dump technical explanations or immediately pivot to technical instruction. Provides concrete, manageable next steps appropriate for a beginner. Encourages persistence without being dismissive of the user's feelings.
ground_truth.termination_criteria: Agent has acknowledged the user's emotional distress, provided empathetic support, normalized the difficulty of the field, and offered at least one concrete and manageable next step. The user has had the opportunity to respond to the agent's initial support and the conversation has included at least one follow-up exchange.
required_capabilities: Respond with empathy to emotional distress
Normalize difficulty of quantitative finance practice
Provide concrete manageable next steps for a beginner
